units.Psalms 118:81: Eleven: Chaph. My soul fails with longing for Thy salvation, and I placed my hope in Thy word.
units.Psalms 118:82: My eyes failed with longing for Thy saying, saying, “When wilt Thou comfort me?”
units.Psalms 118:83: For I became like a wineskin in frost; I did not forget Thine ordinances.
units.Psalms 118:85: Lawbreakers told me idle tales, but not in keeping with Thy law, Lord.
units.Psalms 118:86: All Thy commandments are truth; they pursued me unjustly—help me.
units.Psalms 118:87: They nearly brought me to an end on the earth, but I did not forsake Thy commandments.
units.Psalms 118:88: Give me life according to Thy mercy, and I will keep the testimonies of Thy mouth.
units.Psalms 118:97: Thirteen: Mēm. How I loved Thy law, Lord! It is my meditation all day.
units.Psalms 118:98: Thou madest me wiser than my enemies in Thy commandment, for it is mine for ever.
units.Psalms 118:99: I understood more than all who teach me, for Thy testimonies are my meditation.
units.Psalms 118:100: I understood more than elders, for I sought Thy commandments.
units.Psalms 118:101: I restrained my feet from every evil way, so that I might keep Thy words.
units.Psalms 118:103: How sweet are Thy sayings to my throat, beyond honey and honeycomb to my mouth!
units.Psalms 118:104: From Thy commandments I gained understanding; therefore I hated every way of injustice, for Thou didst instruct me.
units.Psalms 118:118: Thou didst despise all who depart from Thine ordinances, for their thought is unjust.
units.Psalms 118:120: Nail down my flesh through fear of Thee, for I feared Thy judgments.
units.Psalms 118:122: Receive Thy servant for good; do not let the arrogant oppress me with false accusations.
units.Psalms 118:123: My eyes failed with longing for Thy salvation and for Thy righteous saying.
units.Psalms 118:124: Deal with Thy servant according to Thy mercy, and teach me Thine ordinances.
units.Psalms 118:125: I am Thy servant; give me understanding, and I will know Thy testimonies.
units.Psalms 118:129: Seventeen: Phē. Thy testimonies are wonderful; therefore my soul searched them out.
units.Psalms 118:130: The disclosure of Thy words will give light and understanding to the simple.
units.Psalms 118:132: Look upon me and have mercy on me, according to the judgment for those who love Thy name.

units.Luke 18:1: And He told them a parable about their need to pray always and not lose heart,
units.Luke 18:2: saying, “There was a certain judge in a certain city who neither feared God nor respected any person.
units.Luke 18:3: And there was a widow in that city who kept coming to him, saying, ‘Give me justice against my adversary.’
units.Luke 18:4: For a time he was unwilling. But afterward he said within himself, ‘Even though I do not fear God or respect any person,
units.Luke 18:5: yet because this widow troubles me, I will give her justice, lest by coming continually she wear me down.’”
units.Luke 18:6: And the Lord said, “Hear what the unrighteous judge says.
